name: Shenzhen JT Automation Equipment Co.,Ltd
summary: Shenzhen JT Automation Equipment Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, sale, and servicing of electronic assembly equipment in China and internationally. The company offers electronic soldering equipment, such as reflow soldering ovens, wave soldering machines, selective wave soldering machines, and vertical curing ovens; and visual inspection equipment, including automatic optical inspection (AOI) and solder paste printing inspection (SPI) equipment.
